blocks.value: Tell me what I cannot see
blocks.unit: execution, feel, symptoms, fuel, and the next few days
blocks.context: The workout file gives me numbers. A short comment tells me why the numbers looked that way and whether I should change anything.

blocks.title: A Useful Workout Comment
blocks.description: You rarely need an essay. Include these when they affected the workout.

steps.detail: Completed, shortened, changed, or stopped. Say where the prescription broke down.
Easy, controlled, hard, or maximal. Add RPE when it sharpens the picture.
Say what, when, and whether it changed your movement or effort. Do not diagnose it.
For longer work, report approximate carbohydrate and fluid intake and any gut trouble.
Mention travel, poor sleep, schedule collisions, illness, or a limited training window.

blocks.content: **Useful:** ‘3/4 climbs at target. Fourth faded after 8 min; legs 8/10, breathing controlled. 85g carbs/hr, one bottle/hr, no gut issue. Right knee 0/10 during, 2/10 walking downstairs after. Thursday is still open.’
**Too vague:** ‘Done. Felt okay.’ I still do not know where you struggled, what you felt, or whether anything needs to change.
Use this format on your next hard workout. Short and specific beats polished.
